When a melee creature cannot reach an enemy this turn and has no ranged option, Dash toward the nearest enemy reachable by a legal path.
Set stance to close_to_melee, willingness to freely, and movement budget high enough to use the full Dash distance.
If Dash is unavailable, move at the creature's full available budget toward that enemy.
Never end a turn with unused movement while an enemy is out of reach and no ranged option exists.
Use Disengage only to prevent Opportunity Attacks when an enemy is adjacent and the creature intends to move away; otherwise it does nothing.
When no attack is possible and the creature will not move, choose Dodge over Disengage or End Turn.
Use Dodge to impose Disadvantage on attacks against the creature and grant it Advantage on Dexterity saving throws until its next turn.
Use Dash to gain extra movement equal to the creature's Speed for the current turn.
Close quickly against ranged enemies; treat every round spent at distance as free damage for them.
Use only abilities offered by the statblock; never invent an attack, spell, or trait.
